us_election.reading: consolidation — AI held as a strategic asset, access to allies rationed from Washington

events.title: AI Investment Collapse
events.description: Capital flees the sector. Valuations reset hard, announced build-out is cancelled rather than delayed, and several of the arrangements European compute was depending on evaporate with it. What the frontier laboratories can afford to train shrinks for the first time.

events.title: emergent_circuit_tracing_leak
events.description: Details of the EAAD's promising circuit-tracing tool, intended for internal audit use, are leaked to a public research repository. The release triggers a global race to adapt and weaponize the technique, with both defensive applications and offensive countermeasures emerging within weeks. The EU faces a dilemma: reclaim control or double down on open assurance as a strategic standard.

events.title: Open Weights Reach the Frontier
events.description: An open-weight release lands within months of the closed frontier rather than a year. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

portfolio.name: InvestAI Gigafactories
portfolio.description: €200bn fund for four to five sites

portfolio.name: Tech sovereignty package
portfolio.description: Targets €200bn of private capital for AI data centres by 2036 and proposes accelerated-permitting zones

portfolio.name: Establish the European AI Assurance Directorate (EAAD)
portfolio.description: A new public agency to conduct independent pre-deployment evaluations of frontier models and audit safety claims with legal authority to delay releases

portfolio.name: Critical Infrastructure Resilience Surge (CIRS)
portfolio.description: A rapid, targeted hardening of energy, water, and transport control systems against AI-powered intrusion, with mandatory detection upgrades and cross-border red-teaming exercises

portfolio.name: Launch the Sovereign AI Core Programme (SACP)
portfolio.description: Establish a publicly governed, EU-operated AI development and deployment stack — from training infrastructure to agent deployment — capable of reaching 60.0 by turn 8, with full weight control and auditability

portfolio.name: Establish the Sovereign Model Assurance Framework (SMAF)
portfolio.description: A binding technical and legal regime requiring all models trained or operated under the Sovereign AI Core Programme to be fully auditable, weight-secure, and operationally isolated from external infrastructure

portfolio.name: Launch the Public Assurance Protocol
portfolio.description: A binding requirement that all sovereign AI systems above 55.0 capability subject to SMAF or the AI Containment Protocol must publish an annual public assurance report, co-signed by the EAAD and national oversight bodies, explaining their safety architecture, containment measures, and incident history in accessible language

portfolio.name: Launch the Openweight Containment Initiative
portfolio.description: A binding directive requiring all open-weight releases above 45.0 capability to include embedded watermarking, usage tracking, and remote deactivation triggers, enforceable through licensing conditions on EU-based hosting providers and cloud marketplaces
